race.comment: EQUINE HEADLINE (8) has the strongest current form, with consecutive seconds at this track and both defeats narrow. Boasts a good record over this track and trip without winning but is great chance to change that third-up. FASHIZLEMANIZLE (5) resumes and shoulders strong fresh for. Won at his only start at this venue and placed at this distance. Have to take seriously with Crowther piloting. GO ASK ALICE (6) earned respect with a dominant maiden win at this track last start and has the same venue-and-distance profile, but this is a sharper test after breaking through. SHE REX (10) was held up before finishing fourth here last start and finished close enough to be a genuine danger, though this is her first look at around 1000m.
